Evidence

Every action you record is hashed and chained on this device, then encrypted before it syncs to your other devices. Test data stays out of this log. Whether a court accepts this record is for the court.

Your log

Write what you saw, heard or did, in your own words. Each entry carries the time it was written. An edit carries its own time, and the earlier wording is kept beside it.

Before you watch a device

The Watch list is for devices that appear to follow you, such as a tracker, a camera, a drone, or a device Remiel has seen move with you.

It is not for following, locating or learning the movements of another person. In many places that is a crime.

Report misuse to abuse@remielengine.ai.
